title: A display shows as offline
summary: A red status dot or 'Offline' on a display means it has lost power or network. Check how long it has been offline, then fix the connection at the store.
bodyMd:
A display is offline when the player app on the device has stopped reporting to the platform, almost always because the device lost power or its network connection. The fix is at the store; HQ Admin tells you which display, since when, and whether the whole store is affected.

One display shows a red status dot or "Offline"

Cause. The device is switched off, unplugged, or disconnected from the store network.

Fix. In Displays & Devices, hover over the red status icon to see how long it has been offline, then open the display and check the Device Status tab for entries such as "Your display is offline" or "This device is disconnected". Ask the store to check power and network on that device. See View a display's status and time offline.

Every display in a store is offline, and Retail Admin shows "Seems like you are experiencing a Store Wide Internet issue. Contact Admin."

Cause. The store's internet connection is down.

Fix. Restore the store connection first; displays reconnect on their own when it returns.

The display is online but a campaign is not playing

Cause. A playback issue rather than an offline device.

Fix. See Identify campaign playback issues on a display.

To hear about outages before the store does, set up an email alert under Displays & Devices → Offline Device Notifications — see Get notified when a display goes offline.
